profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Developer, Graphic Designer, Digital Strategist, and Project Manager with a Passion for AI and Smart Systems
profile.jobTitle: Freelance Senior Full-Stack Web Developer, Digital Strategist, and Creative Director
profile.summary:
Senior Full-Stack Developer, Digital Strategist, Creative Technologist, Graphic Designer, and creative problem solver with 15+ years of experience at the intersection of web development, UX/UI design, branding, and digital strategy. For 13 years, I owned all technical and creative operations for a single company, delivering websites, custom internal applications, marketing systems, and high-impact digital assets from the ground up.

Anchored by a strong foundation in graphic design, I bring sharp visual judgment to every build, pairing robust engineering with clean, user-focused interfaces. I specialize in crafting cohesive brand identities, intuitive user experiences, and engaging visuals that elevate products and campaigns across web, mobile, and multimedia platforms.

I specialize in building utilitarian web applications that solve real problems, streamline workflows, and create measurable business value. Since 2022, I have been deeply immersed in AI, both following and developing with the latest models and tools. I stay current on model capabilities and strengths, and I know when and how to apply them effectively. From prompt and context engineering to integrating AI into everyday products, I focus on practical, reliable implementations that connect advanced technology with clear, usable outcomes.

positions.title: Freelance Senior Full-Stack Web Developer, Digital Strategist, and Creative Director
positions.description:
Freelance senior full-stack web developer, digital strategist, and creative director helping brands, founders, and teams turn ideas into polished products and measurable results.

Since 2008 I have led end-to-end delivery for 100+ projects across SaaS, ecommerce, B2B, and entertainment - from discovery and UX through launch and ongoing optimization. 

• Architecting high converting WordPress and WooCommerce ecosystems drove thousands of conversions and 7 figure revenue gains.

• Building custom Laravel and Node apps, internal tools, and AI assisted workflows that streamline operations and unlock new services.

• Creating brand systems, album art, tour visuals, and motion graphics for artists and labels including Maybach Music Group, Nappy Boy Entertainment, and independent comedians, authors, and spiritual organizations.

• Leading creative for digital campaigns, mobile apps, and communities including the Maybach Music Group MMG logo, DeeperThanRap.com social network, and T Pain related projects.

• Acting as long term digital partner for small businesses - advising on strategy, analytics, paid media, SEO, and tech stack decisions while handling hands on implementation.

• Owning hosting, security, and performance, often stepping in to rescue hacked or fragile sites and stabilize them for growth.

Clients describe me as a rare blend of creative partner and technical problem solver who brings fresh ideas, fast turnaround, and calm, accountable execution on high stakes work.

positions.title: Founder, Senior Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Developing utilitarian, mobile-first SaaS and Open Source applications with a focus on AI integration and real-time collaboration.

Current Projects:


Unobtuse ID8: Real-time idea tracking and collaboration app built with React Native, Node.js, and Socket.io.


Unobtuse Ledger: Personal finance SaaS integrating Plaid and OpenAI for banking data and analysis (Laravel 12, Livewire, PostgreSQL).


Unobtuse Resume: Privacy-first career tool leveraging local and cloud AI models (Ollama, OpenAI) for resume optimization and ATS-friendly exports (Node.js, Puppeteer).


Unobtuse Health: AI-powered health tracking platform for analyzing biometrics and diet (Laravel 11, Tailwind, Redis).


Unobtuse Grocer: Modern, real-time collaborative list management using React 18 and Socket.io.

positions.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer, Digital Strategist, IT Manager
positions.description:
Spearheaded complete digital transformation of a B2B office furniture company, growing from intern to sole technical and creative lead. Managed all web development, digital marketing, brand strategy, and IT infrastructure, increasing annual revenue by $1M through strategic WordPress development and targeted digital marketing.

Key metrics and achievements:
• Architected  WooCommerce platform that contributed to a 1M annual revenue increase
• Generated 4,800+ $4-5 figure conversions through website quote request forms
• Replaced $60K 3-month low ROI traditional ad spend with ~$7K/yr digital campaigns
• Achieved 2% CTR on ads, significantly above industry average
• Eliminated external IT vendor costs by handling all IT in house

Full-Stack Development:
• Developed separate internal Laravel business intelligence application seamlessly integrating Quickbooks and WooCommerce  via REST APIs, streamlining workflows , delivering real time inventory, sales trends, and P and L style insights in a simple dashboard  used daily by staff.
• Engineered quote system to replace "add to cart", strategically aligning the site with the company’s B2B, in-showroom sales model.
• Created 1,000+ product listings, with consistent professional photography, detailed descriptions, and specs
• Developed AI powered plugins for SEO optimized product descriptions 
• Led ongoing redesign bringing the site to current UX, mobile first, and performance standards

Marketing:
• Filmed & edited professional commercials & creative assets
• Launched optimized Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and LinkedIn Ads strategically targeting B2B decision makers
• Conducted & Filmed Customer Interviews for Success Story Testimonial Videos
• Designed vehicle fleet graphics and coordinated with installers

Operations and IT management:
• Served as sole IT support for staff, handling all desktop deployments, POS, troubleshooting, and PCI compliant network setup
• Administered Google Workspace & AWS Services (EC2, S3, EBS, RDS)

positions.title: Web Developer & IT Consultant
positions.description:
• Rescued AnyFence.com from a serious SQL injection attack, cleaned the site, hardened security, and restored compliance so Google Ads could resume running.

• Redesigned and Re-architected the company website into a 1,000+ page, SEO-optimized WordPress platform using advanced taxonomies and smart location + fence type landing pages.

• Wrote educational, conversion-focused content that explains fence types, materials, and installation options in plain language for homeowners and commercial buyers.

• Implemented tracking and optimized Google Ads so the site consistently generates qualified quote requests, contributing to 700+ conversions to date.

• Serve as ongoing web and IT advisor to ownership, identifying wasteful spend, managing Google Workspace and technical vendors, and focusing budget on what actually drives results.

positions.title: Lead WordPress Developer, Graphic Designer, and E-commerce Consultant
positions.description:
• Designed and developed the full WordPress and WooCommerce site for online spirits sales, including product catalog, search, and filtering.

• Designed Logo and incorporated SVG animation.

• Implemented age-verification and state-based shipping restriction logic to keep alcohol sales compliant while maintaining a smooth checkout flow.

• Set up inventory management, product variations, and payment gateway configuration to support day-to-day operations.

• Created a high-end visual design and content structure that matched the premium positioning of the brand, including the company social media pages.

• Provided ongoing technical guidance and optimization as a trusted strategic partner.
positions.insights: QuickBooks Online, Social Media Marketing and +33 skills

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Committee to Elect Frantz Pierre
volunteerExperiences.description:
• Full-Cycle Web Development: Architected and launched votepierre.com on a VPS infrastructure, serving as the central hub for two consecutive City Council election cycles (2021 & 2023).

• Fundraising Operations: Engineered a secure, high-volume donation funnel integrating PayPal and ActBlue; successfully processed and tracked hundreds of grassroots contributions with zero downtime during critical fundraising pushes.

• Digital Strategy & Content: Collaborated with campaign leadership to distribute digital assets, including managing Zoom event logistics for virtual town halls and ensuring consistent branding across web and social platforms.

• Technical Administration: Served as the primary technical point of contact, managing hosting, site security, and rapid content updates to align with the fast-paced nature of a municipal political campaign.

company.name: The Committee to Elect Frantz Pierre
